podcast.title: Plaintiff in "Uptown Funk" Lawsuit
podcast.body: Kalash was one of the groups that sued Bruno Mars and Mark Ronson regarding the song "Uptown Funk," resulting in multiple additional parties sharing in its songwriting credits and royalties. "They were sued by the Gap Band, a rap group called The Sequence, another called Kalash, and another called Zap."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
